C53519.observed: What was checked: that the Invoice Design chooser offers exactly two choices with one of them already selected. What happened: it does. Opening it shows exactly two, Modern and Legacy, and Legacy carries the tick. There is no third choice and nothing is left unselected.

C53524.observed: What was checked: that choosing Legacy asks you to confirm, with the exact wording. What happened: it does, word for word. The window reads 'Switch to the Legacy design?' and underneath, 'Every estimate, invoice and credit invoice will use the Legacy design straight away, including documents your shop has already sent. Reprints and portal copies of older documents change too. You can switch back at any time.' The two buttons are Cancel and Switch To Legacy.
C53524.not_observed: The button reads 'Switch To Legacy' with a capital T, where the written requirement writes 'Switch to Legacy'. That is the app's standard button styling and was explicitly accepted by the product owner, so it is not a fault.

C53525.observed: What was checked: that choosing Modern asks you to confirm, with the exact wording. What happened: it does, word for word. The window reads 'Switch to the Modern design?' and underneath, 'Every estimate, invoice and credit invoice will use the Modern design straight away, including documents your shop has already sent. Reprints and portal copies of older documents change too. You can switch back at any time.' The two buttons are Cancel and Switch To Modern.
C53525.not_observed: The button reads 'Switch To Modern' with a capital T, the app's standard button styling, explicitly accepted by the product owner.

C53526.observed: What was checked: that confirming the change saves it and tells you so. What happened: both. On confirming, a message appeared reading exactly 'Invoice design updated.' and it faded on its own. Leaving the page and coming back showed the new choice still in place, so it really was saved. Nothing else had to be pressed to save it.

C53528.observed: What was checked: that the choice can be changed as often as you like, in either direction. What happened: it can. It was switched from Legacy to Modern, then back from Modern to Legacy, in one sitting. Both directions asked to confirm, both saved, and nothing refused the second change or asked to wait.

C53530.observed: What was checked: that pressing Cancel on the confirmation leaves everything as it was. What happened: it does. The chooser was set to Modern and Cancel was pressed. The setting went straight back to Legacy, where it started, and nothing was saved.

C53532.observed: What was checked: that changing the design leaves the other invoice settings alone. What happened: it does. The nine other switches on the Invoice tab were recorded before the change and read again after it, and every one of them was exactly as it had been.

C53527.observed: What was checked: that a new choice takes effect straight away on the documents you look at next. What happened: it does. Immediately after switching, the same ten documents were opened again and every one of them came back in the newly chosen design, with no waiting and nothing to re-issue.

C53531.observed: What was checked: that changing the design does not alter any document itself - its contents, its lines or its totals. What happened: it does not. Ten documents were opened under Legacy and then again under Modern. The document numbers were identical both times, and on the document examined line by line the Subtotal, Tax, Total, Balance and Shop Supplies figures were identical to the penny under both designs. Only the appearance changed.

C53534.observed: What was checked: that a work order invoice comes out in whichever design the shop has chosen right now. What happened: it does. Five work order invoices were opened with the setting on Legacy and then again with it on Modern, and every one of them changed design. None of them kept the look it had before.

C53539.observed: What was checked: that an invoice follows the current choice no matter what stage it has reached. What happened: it does. The five invoices used were at different stages and every one of them changed design when the setting changed - none of them was left behind.

C53544.observed: What was checked: that an estimate always comes out in whichever design is chosen right now. What happened: it does. Five estimates were opened under Legacy and again under Modern and every one changed design.

C53547.observed: What was checked: that an estimate that has not been invoiced comes out in the design chosen right now. What happened: it does. Every estimate opened changed design when the setting changed.

C53549.observed: What was checked: that changing the setting makes every estimate come out differently the next time it is opened. What happened: it does. After the switch, all five estimates were opened again and all five had changed - there was no delay and nothing had to be re-issued.

C53553.observed: What was checked: that an older document, created long before this setting existed, still follows the setting chosen now. What happened: it does. The documents used were existing ones on the system, not made for this check, and all of them changed design when the setting changed. When a document was created makes no difference.

C53563.observed: What was checked: that looking at a document on screen shows it in the design chosen right now. What happened: it does. Every one of the ten documents opened on screen came back in whichever design was selected at the time.
